facts.statement: Only the release ending grounds Azure Cloud. Shared and covenant routes leave it aloft.
Lin Yue retains the intact pendant on every continuing route.
Nineteen household records were erased last winter. Their living occupants were not swallowed or killed; tablets shelter their names.
Su Lan's husband died seven winters before Book II; his memorial record vanished last winter, six winters after his death.
Wei Xiu carved the crossing stone and works at the north landing. Her household claim was erased, not her life.
Other investigators attend the assembly and present evidence from roads Lin Yue did not visit. Privacy permissions remain binding.
Every Book II ending restores household records through a hearing or the bell. Seed growth is optional future shelter, never a condition of rights.
Book II begins in autumn. Every Book III route begins the following spring; seed's spring ending is not followed by a second winter. Su Lan's husband has now been dead eight winters.
Echoes are volunteered external copies. Original minds retain their memories. Rings do not read unoffered thoughts; sealed return is distinct from permission to listen.
The ferry holds Mo Ran's echo, Luo Fen's echo, and one unidentified sealed echo. Luo Fen is alive. No route opens any echo or treats an unknown owner as abandoning property.

The keeper died two summers before Book III; Willow Reach's east stair was lost in the intervening winter flood. A stop clause permits sheltered waiting. Eight-day interim watches are explicitly extended before ten-day stair construction completes.
The Eel accepts every changed return or holding arrangement. Owner permission is separate for each ring; pilots may refuse unsafe landings; the spirit may ask for rest.
The third ring's owner remains an intentional unresolved mystery in every Book III ending. A later chapter must identify the owner through permitted records, not open the echo to guess.

review_policy: Review each new chapter's chronology, custody, character knowledge, and alternate outcomes before updating this ledger. Structural checks supplement editorial review; they do not prove the absence of all possible plot holes.
